name: Git Lens
description: GitLens-inspired local Git management for PI-Desktop: status, history, diff, blame, branches, commits and stashes. Ships an isolated multi-view panel, agent tools the AI can call, and an AI-callable tool that opens any panel page on demand.

en.name: Git Lens
en.description: GitLens-inspired local Git management for PI-Desktop: status, history, diff, blame, branches, commits and stashes. Ships an isolated multi-view panel, agent tools the AI can call, and an AI-callable tool that opens any panel page on demand.
en.safetyNotes: Runs the system git binary (git on PATH) against the repository root resolved from the currently open workspace; the plugin never touches files outside that repository, never passes shell strings (execFile with argument arrays, no shell), never sends network requests, and never reads credentials.

zh-CN.name: Git Lens
zh-CN.description: 受 GitLens 启发的 PI-Desktop 本地 Git 管理工具：查看状态、历史、差异、逐行追踪、分支、提交和 Stash。提供隔离的多视图面板、可供 AI 调用的 Git 工具，以及能按需打开指定面板页面的工具。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 插件只针对当前工作区解析出的仓库根目录执行系统 git，不访问仓库之外的文件，不拼接 shell 命令，不发起网络请求，也不读取凭据。

author: PI-Desktop
changelog: Release 0.1.3: migrates the panel to v3 paint-through chrome and restores full viewport height without the legacy 46px double subtraction. Release 0.1.2: tightens responsive spacing, focus treatment, and control sizing on top of the PI-Desktop design system. Release 0.1.1: restyles the panel to mirror the PI-Desktop design system exactly — the purple accent and bespoke palette are replaced by the app's neutral monochrome accent and `--ds-*` tokens (surfaces, text tiers, borders, radii, type ramp), semantic git colors map to the app's success/warning/error tokens, and a contributed app theme now re-skins the panel the same way it re-skins the shell. No behavior, tool, command or permission changes.
safetyNotes: Runs the system git binary (git on PATH) against the repository root resolved from the currently open workspace; the plugin never touches files outside that repository, never passes shell strings (execFile with argument arrays, no shell), never sends network requests, and never reads credentials. Commits, branch switches/deletes and stash operations are local git operations that respect repository hooks; the tools cannot push, pull, fetch or force anything beyond explicit branch deletion (git branch -D only when the caller asks for force). The panel is an isolated, context-isolated window that talks to the plugin process through the host bridge only.

agentTools.name: git_status
agentTools.description: Show the git status of the current project's repository: current branch, upstream, ahead/behind counts, and the working tree grouped into staged, unstaged, untracked and conflict entries (porcelain XY codes, rename pairs included). Read-only.

path.description: Optional repository-relative path to limit the status to.

agentTools.name: git_log
agentTools.description: Show recent commit history of the current project's repository. Supports an optional repo-relative path, free-text grep over subjects, an author filter and a result count. Returns sha, short sha, author, dates, subject, body and ref decorations for each commit. Read-only.

path.description: Optional repository-relative path to show history for (file or directory).

query.description: Optional free-text matched against commit subjects (case-insensitive grep).

count.description: Maximum number of commits to return (default 20).

agentTools.name: git_show
agentTools.description: Show a single commit of the current project's repository: message, author, dates, changed files with add/delete counts, and optionally the full patch. Use a sha, HEAD or any ref expression as ref. Read-only.

ref.description: Commit to show. Defaults to HEAD.

path.description: Optional repository-relative path to limit the shown files.

patch.description: Include the unified diff patch (default false; large patches are truncated).

agentTools.name: git_diff
agentTools.description: Show the diff of the current project's repository: between a base ref and the working tree (default), or between two refs. Returns changed files with add/delete counts and optionally the unified patch. Read-only.

base.description: Base ref for the diff. Defaults to HEAD.

target.description: Optional second ref. When omitted the working tree is compared against base.

path.description: Optional repository-relative path to limit the diff to.

patch.description: Include the unified diff patch (default false; large patches are truncated).

agentTools.name: git_blame
agentTools.description: Blame a file in the current project's repository (GitLens-style line attribution): for every line, the originating commit sha, author, author time and commit subject. Path is required; an optional line range limits the output. Read-only.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the file to blame.

startLine.description: Optional first line of the blame range (1-based, inclusive).

endLine.description: Optional last line of the blame range (1-based, inclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of blamed lines to return (default 2000; set higher for large files).

agentTools.name: git_branch
agentTools.description: Manage local branches of the current project's repository. Actions: list (default, includes current branch, upstream and last commit), create (new branch from an optional start point), switch (checkout an existing local branch), delete (safe delete; fails on unmerged branches unless force is set).

name.description: Branch name for create/switch/delete. Must be a safe git ref name.

startPoint.description: Optional ref the new branch starts from (create only).

force.description: For delete: force delete even if unmerged. For create: reset an existing branch to the start point.

agentTools.name: git_commit
agentTools.description: Stage changes and create a commit in the current project's repository. stage can be 'all' (git add -A), 'tracked' (git add -u) or an array of repo-relative paths. Respects repository hooks and never skips verification. Returns the new commit sha and subject.

amend.description: Amend the last commit instead of creating a new one (default false).

agentTools.name: git_stash
agentTools.description: Manage the stash of the current project's repository. Actions: list (default), push (stash the working tree with an optional message; includeUntracked adds -u), pop (restore the newest stash or the one at index), drop (delete the newest stash or the one at index).

includeUntracked.description: Include untracked files when pushing (default false).

agentTools.name: git_open_panel
agentTools.description: Open the Git Lens panel in PI-Desktop on a specific page (overview, history, diff, branches or blame). Use this when the user asks to see git information in a visual page, wants a dashboard of the repository, or asks to 'open' git history/changes/branches/blame. Optionally preselect a path (blame/diff/history) or a ref.

path.description: Optional repository-relative path to preselect on the page.

ref.description: Optional ref to focus (e.g. a commit sha) where the page supports it.
